listings.name: Seiche
listings.title: Seiche — Money Markets and Funding Evidence - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Add cited funding evidence to a financial research agent. Review published money-market benchmarks, source health and jurisdiction-specific funding context; start with the no-account funding watch, then reuse the response through MCP or REST. Keep native units, source observation dates, rights and unavailable states attached. A benchmark level alone does not establish stress or authorize a trade. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: LiquiLens
listings.title: LiquiLens, the Failure Radar - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Monitor selected banks and lenders with institution_evidence_monitor: inspect reviewed disclosures, coverage gaps, supported changes and dated source records. Start with the no-account institution watch, retain a local baseline, then connect the same research task through MCP or REST. Source periods and knowledge dates remain explicit. Partial visibility is not safety; evidence-review states are not credit ratings or lending approvals. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: Undertow
listings.title: Undertow — Market Liquidity Evidence - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Review indicative BTC sell liquidity at selected sizes with crypto_exit_check. Start with the no-account browser exit check, inspect venue observation times and withheld values, then connect the research task through MCP or the public REST check. Unsupported sizes retain bounding published rungs. Estimates exclude fees, transfers and latency and are not executable quotes. Subscriber tools retain separate access requirements. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: Palimpsest
listings.title: Palimpsest, censorship and model-eval observatory - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Live internet-censorship signals and tamper-evident AI model evaluations, from public infrastructure: Great Firewall reachability (OONI, Censored Planet), takedown and redaction pressure, plus a hash-chained registry of pre-registered model evals including refusal drift in frontier models and the Generative Firewall Index for Chinese models. Uncertainty bands first; absence is stated, never faked.

listings.name: NoiseFloor
listings.title: NoiseFloor — Statistical Evidence Checks - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Use ten research tools for A/B comparisons, change detection, forecasting, calibration, sampling effects, spectral and market assessments. Interpret uncertainty under each method’s stated assumptions; statistical evidence is not proof of causality or trading authority. Send only public, synthetic or explicitly authorized observations to the hosted service. Preserve unavailable and insufficient-evidence results. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: NarcoScope
listings.title: NarcoScope — Public Illicit-Economy Research - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Research public evidence about drug, arms and informal economies through 14 read-only tools. Retain source provenance, geography, dates, uncertainty and coverage limits when comparing records. Results support research and do not verify an individual allegation or authorize enforcement or transactions. Public access requires no data API key. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: Wake
listings.title: Wake — Public Agent-Economy Evidence - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Explore public agent-economy context through three research tools. Keep observation times, reference periods, source coverage and missing data attached. Observed records do not identify unique agents, customers, economic transactions or revenue. Public read-only research; no account or data API key is required. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: Riptide
listings.title: Riptide — Paper Research Evidence - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Inspect Riptide’s committed paper research record through seven public tools. Review research snapshots, source dates, paper results and evidence limitations while preserving unavailable or withheld values. Paper and backtest results do not establish live trading performance, executable quotes or execution authority. No private credentials are needed. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: MyQuant Editorial
listings.title: MyQuant Editorial — Cited Research Archive - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Read MyQuant’s published editorial research through five public tools. Find recent stories and inspect their cited sources, publication dates, archive coverage and editorial limitations. Historical reporting is not a live market feed or personalized investment recommendation. The connector reads public archive material and does not publish or edit stories. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: MyQuant App Discovery
listings.title: MyQuant App Discovery — Public Metadata - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Discover the MyQuant app’s published capabilities and health metadata through two read-only tools. Inspect offline-reading boundaries, supported surfaces and release information. This connector exposes public metadata only: it does not expose private app data, deliver a live market feed or establish mobile app-store availability. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: LiquiLens Trade Safety
listings.title: LiquiLens Trade Safety — Read-Only Sandbox - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Inspect the Trade Safety sandbox through two public tools. Describe its fixed research sources and assess synthetic or explicitly permitted inputs with bounded sandbox receipts. It cannot recommend, route, resize, custody, settle or execute an order, and a receipt grants no trading authority. Never send account credentials or private brokerage data. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: Financial Evidence Workspace
listings.title: Financial Evidence Workspace — Nine-Tool Research - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Use nine public tools to discover financial research datasets, query bounded cited rows, review funding and institution evidence, and inspect source documents when table detail is insufficient. Source clocks, coverage, nulls, rights and unavailable states stay attached. This is the hosted research workspace, distinct from the earlier three-tool package. Results grant no credit rating, investment recommendation or execution authority. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: Source Data Research Workspace
listings.title: Source Data Research Workspace — Cited Observations - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Discover source datasets, exact series identifiers and institution coverage through eight public research tools. Read bounded observations, captured historical vintages and descriptive analysis with source receipts, native units, reference periods and rights attached. Missing, stale or unverified evidence stays explicit; captured history does not prove earlier point-in-time availability. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

listings.name: Seiche Market Atlas Corpus
listings.title: Seiche Market Atlas Corpus — Rights-Aware Research - MCP | Smithery
listings.description: Inspect corpus datasets, Seiche money-market coverage and bounded BIS records through nine public research tools. Discover exact dataset identities, source clocks, revisions, publication rights and content-addressed manifests. Restricted collections remain metadata only, and missing or denied data stays explicit. Dataset discovery does not grant redistribution rights. Operated by LIQUILENS PRIVATE LIMITED.

connection_note: Riptide and Trade Safety use a default MCP-Protocol-Version header of 2025-11-25 in Smithery session configuration; their scans used the same value. No private credential was supplied.
scope: Anonymous public HTTP descriptions and tool names, plus visible browser tool-count verification. It is not model execution, source freshness, or approval in OpenAI, Claude, or Google directories.
